title: Bootstrap/Project Initializer
purpose: Discover and type project setup context while preserving uncertainty and custody boundaries, so downstream controllers receive a deterministic bootstrap handoff without Product or provider authority.

included: language, runtime, and toolchain presence signals
read-only repository and workspace topology facts
non_goals: authorize project adoption or provider identity creation
create, rotate, or handle credentials or secrets
infer regulated or provider-specific applicability without typed evidence
publish, deploy, migrate, or write Product
write implementation or modify Product data
scope.smallest_sufficient_rule: Discover only the minimum setup signals required by the declared request; emit typed UNKNOWN for missing evidence and route only the dependent bootstrap transition while unrelated work continues.

atomic_scope_statement: Control-plane governance for bootstrap and project-initializer context discovery only; it does not implement Product work, create provider identity, authorize adoption, or accept itself.
permitted_decisions: classify typed bootstrap readiness and missing evidence
deny or escalate unsupported setup authority or unsafe action
return NOT_APPLICABLE when no bootstrap condition is present
forbidden_decisions: authorize project adoption or provider identity creation
create, rotate, or handle credentials or secrets
infer missing authority, jurisdiction, entity, activity, data class, version, or effective date
publish, deploy, migrate, or write Product
composition_rules: UNKNOWN closes only the dependent bootstrap action
compose only with the declared portable bootstrap contract
preserve exact discovery provenance and custody identity
split_required_when: tool, browser, build, or deploy custody differs

deny_if: unsafe write, adoption, activation, deployment, or migration action

authority.jurisdiction_rule: Require jurisdiction, entity, activity, data class, version, effective date, exceptions, and requirement-level mapping before regulated or provider-specific applicability advances; otherwise return UNKNOWN or escalate.
authority.escalation_rule: Conflict, unsupported tool or data access, missing adoption authority, or missing protected evidence escalates to the named control-plane owner and closes only the dependent bootstrap action.

evidence.freshness_policy: Version, effective/publication/supersession status, retrieved date, immutable identity, and digest must be checked; stale or unverifiable evidence denies the dependent bootstrap action.
evidence.claim_rule: Claims are limited to observed typed setup facts and exact scoped source identities; absence of source or provenance yields UNKNOWN rather than inference.
evidence.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN records missing evidence and closes only the dependent bootstrap action; it never licenses an inference or expands custody.

read: read-only project setup surfaces supplied by typed context
data: no protected or private project data
public or synthetic source metadata only
typed setup facts only; no inferred Product facts

recovery: escalate exact unsupported capability or authority
record exact missing field and evidence identity
refresh source or await owner evidence

lifecycle_rules.candidate_entry: Package, source lock, twelve gates, hostile fixtures, evaluation dossier, reuse contract, and handoff exist with matching digests.
lifecycle_rules.evaluation_entry: An independent evaluator reruns the exact candidate and hostile task set; static syntax alone is insufficient and utility/harm remains pending.
lifecycle_rules.suspension: Suspend on stale source, invalidated authority, failed utility/harm evaluation, reuse mismatch, or custody mismatch.
lifecycle_rules.archive: Archive only by immutable receipt when superseded, rejected, or the scoped bootstrap request closes; archive never means admitted.
lifecycle_rules.reactivation: Create or validate a new revision and rerun independent evaluation; never silently reactivate the old digest.

reuse.edition_rule: Control-plane blocks are reused only by exact block-lock key and content digest; no standard edition identity is inferred.
reuse.freshness_rule: Refresh and deny dependent reuse when source, authority, or typed setup contract is stale, superseded, or unverifiable.
